retrievals.query: Native web research for Robby investment evidence: team, product, market, traction, competitors, freshness

claims.claim: YC lists three founders with engineering and operating backgrounds at Affinity, Cloud Health Systems, Porter, Ironclad, Uber, and Bain, plus prior home-services strategy experience.

Robby combines customer, technician, and third-party data to surface high-intent opportunities, generate technician talking points, capture insights with voice AI, and give GMs a revenue command center.
Home-services businesses have recurring missed-lead and technician-utilization problems, creating a direct revenue-expansion wedge for SMB operators.
Robby reports several paying customers each uncovering six figures of additional revenue opportunities weekly and a first-day close of $40,000 in new business within an hour.
YC lists Robby as active in the Winter 2026 batch with three employees.
